domains.name: Command-Line Interaction Contracts
domains.scope: Specify machine streams, completion evidence, literal operands and argument boundaries for command-line tools.

skills.name: command-machine-stream-contract
skills.description: Define machine-readable command input, result, diagnostic, and completion behavior when a command must work reliably in pipelines and unattended jobs.

skills.name: literal-operand-parsing-contract
skills.description: Specify how a command distinguishes options from literal operands when filenames, spaces, delimiters, and standard-input markers could otherwise change their meaning.
